$comment: Maps the 69 catalog workflows to the webpet suite (tests/webpet/). The journey
suite needs no entry here — its runner rows already carry a `workflow` column,
`depth` is the judgement this file exists to hold — it says what the specs cover,
never whether they passed. Run state is joined from docs/catalog/runs/*.json, so a
workflow can read depth=screens and run_state=skipped-only at the same time.
journey  the workflow's end-to-end path is automated
screens  its screens and records are exercised (CRUD, validation, permissions),
but not the multi-step path the catalog describes
partial  one slice of the workflow only
`webpetSpecs` paths are relative to tests/webpet/ and are validated by
`npm run coverage:trace -- --check`. Reachability (ui / device / calc) is NOT
authored here — it comes from the catalog's own `surface` field.
